sources.title: El Salvador Travel: official 2026 events calendar
sources.authority: Ministerio de Turismo / Corporación Salvadoreña de Turismo, El Salvador
sources.supports: Read directly: explicit named local festival dates for November and December 2026; location retained and no 2027 recurrence inferred.

culture-cycles.note: Published local 2026 cultural event dates only, not statutory department-wide public holidays or confirmation of road/business closures. No 2027 dates inferred. Check organiser updates, public access and photography arrangements. A reversed Quezaltepeque date range elsewhere in the calendar was not used.
